usage: ‘次’ is a measure word used to count times or repetitions of an action.
It is often used in sports or exercise contexts to indicate the number of reps.
You can use it after a verb to specify how many times you did that action, e.g. '做咗10次' (did 10 reps).
It can also be used more generally to talk about how many times something happened.
When used in a sentence, it typically appears after a number and before a noun or a verb phrase.
